comments.text: A lot of people see Sumi in a light-hearted and comical way. And while that's certainly a part of her, I think where she shines most when taken seriously. She's the voice of the generations of teens society has neglected since the 2000s. She is healthy selfishness and self-importance warped to an unhealthy and self-damaging levels as an act of rebellion. Or perhaps, a cry for help. She reminds me not to give up, because even if you don't think so, you'll eventually find a space that accepts you.
